meta.title: Genixo – Your Software Department, AI Included
meta.description: Genixo is a software and AI team at Bilkent Cyberpark, Ankara. We automate processes with human approval, build custom software and run NGSD teams.

hero.lead: We measure how the work gets done today, add AI as steps your team approves, build the system and stay to run it.

sections.label: Where to start
sections.title: Which one sounds like you?
sections.lead: Four ways in. Each one begins with a single, clearly scoped first step.

items.quote: My team does the same work by hand every day, and mistakes slip through.
items.name: AI process automation
items.text: AI reads documents, drafts quotes and sorts requests. Your team checks and approves every result that matters.

items.quote: Off-the-shelf software doesn't fit us and doesn't talk to our ERP.
items.name: Custom software
items.text: Internal systems, ERP and e-invoice integrations, field apps and reporting built around how you already work.

items.quote: I have a product idea but no team to build it.
items.name: Product studio
items.text: From a validated idea to a live web or mobile product. The code, store accounts and design files are yours.

items.quote: We need software all the time, but not a whole department.
items.name: NGSD
items.text: An ongoing Genixo team with an assigned project manager, weekly priorities and a weekly demo.

sections.label: How we approach AI
sections.title: Most AI pilots fail at integration, not at the model
sections.lead: In MIT NANDA's 2025 study, as reported by Fortune, only about 5% of enterprise generative AI pilots produced rapid revenue growth; most had little measurable effect on profit and loss. The researchers pointed to how the tools fit real workflows, not to model quality. We work from that finding.

items.title: We measure first.
items.text: Before we build, we write down how long the work takes today and what “better” means. The pilot is judged against that baseline, not against a demo.

items.title: You stay in control.
items.text: AI suggests, your team approves. You decide where the data lives. The code and the intellectual property belong to you. [[TODO-028]]

items.title: We stay after launch.
items.text: Processes change and models need checking. After go-live we keep measuring and adjusting, as a follow-up phase or through NGSD. [[TODO-033]]

sources.title: Fortune, 18 August 2025: MIT report on generative AI pilots (MIT NANDA, “The GenAI Divide”)

items.title: Measure
items.text: We map one process: its volume, the time it takes and where errors appear.

items.title: Pilot
items.text: We build the smallest version that can run on real work, with a baseline and a target agreed in writing.

items.title: Launch
items.text: We connect it to your systems, train the people who use it and plan the switch-over with your team.

items.title: Improve
items.text: We review the numbers after go-live and keep refining what the measurements point to.

sections.label: Why we do this
sections.title: AI is an engineering tool. It belongs where it does measurable work.
paragraphs: AI is now a lasting part of how work gets done. We don't treat it as a trend or a shortcut. Put in the right place, it is a tool that lets your team get more done in the same time, with fewer errors.

To find that place, we first understand your work, keep people in control of the decisions and keep measuring after the system is live. You don't have to do this alone: we move together, step by step, and we measure as we go.

cta.title: Which process costs your business the most time?
cta.lead: In 30 minutes we'll tell you where software and AI would make a real difference. If we're not the right fit, we'll say so.
